Disposition RE-FILED under a heading the driver's owner-gated check can see (OWNER-ESCALATION token + func name on one line); floor re-measured 2/202, both endgame gates re-run and FAIL, FAKE ablation

frontier.hypothesis: sched2 can be made to emit dx before az without moving dx's birth earlier, closing the last two instructions.
frontier.mechanism: rank_for_schedule ties on INSN_PRIORITY and dependence class and falls through to INSN_LUID (sched.c:2464); the LUID fix is self-cancelling against the local-alloc span that buys the register seats (s12 d5 = 9). A fix needs an asymmetry in the first two comparisons or a post-reload hard-register dependence blocking az until after dx - no ordinary-C spelling for either has been found in 14 sessions.
frontier.next_probe: Only re-openable under re-activation trigger (1) or (2) in the filed entry: a class grant covering an insn-positioning construct, or a toolchain change to rank_for_schedule's tie-break inputs (CC_FLAGS of the -mel / -msoft-float class, or a maspsx/ASPSX fidelity gate altering pre-reload insn counts in block 7). Either voids every chassis-relative kill here and the ledger's re-measurement discipline re-opens the function.
